stem: A data team needs one service to enforce centrally managed, fine-grained permissions on S3-backed tables across many users, and a separate service to build interactive dashboards for business stakeholders. Which TWO services fit these two needs respectively? (Select TWO.)

choices.text: AWS Lake Formation for the centrally managed permissions
Amazon Athena for the centrally managed permissions
A Glue ETL job for the interactive dashboards
Amazon QuickSight for the interactive dashboards
Amazon EMR for the centrally managed permissions

rationale: Lake Formation's grant/revoke model centrally manages fine-grained permissions on Data Catalog tables and databases, and QuickSight builds the interactive dashboards business stakeholders view. Athena queries cataloged data but has no permission-management model of its own. A Glue ETL job runs a scheduled data transform; it has no dashboard-building capability at all. EMR is a compute cluster for processing jobs, with no role in managing table-level permissions.
